items.text: Bandar Abbas has been attacked again. No further details are provided in the text. This news was published by the source Vahid Online.

Shahram Khaledi referred to Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf's remarks, stating that the Islamic Republic tries to maintain its suppressive forces through demonization and dehumanization during crises. He noted that the current situation differs due to the severity of the economic crisis. He also mentioned that the government is worried about the gradual loss of suppressive forces.

On the early morning of Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar, the execution of a prisoner in Zahedan prison was carried out. The prisoner had been sentenced to death for theft and rape. The execution took place in Zahedan prison.

A 12-year-old child named Mohammad Tarek was killed during a wedding ceremony in Dashtiari due to celebratory gunfire. This incident occurred following the traditional shooting practice. The tradition and easy access to weapons have been frequently criticized.
Fars news agency reported hearing several explosions in Konarak and Chabahar on Tuesday night. People in these areas heard the explosion sounds. No further details have been provided.

CENTCOM announced that on Tuesday at 19:30 Tehran time, US forces launched attacks on IRGC targets in Iran. These attacks followed recent IRGC attempts to attack commercial ships and US forces in the region. CENTCOM described the action as a response to recent IRGC threats.

An environmental activist in Kermanshah was injured due to a landmine explosion during firefighting operations in the Bozin and Markhil protected area. The mine was left over from the Iran-Iraq war. The injury occurred in the leg.

In recent months, government interventions in areas such as closing cafes, blocking Instagram pages, and confronting tourism tours have increased. These actions are part of social control policies and limiting social autonomy in Iran. The main issue is the expansion of government interference in freedom of expression, privacy, and the right to participate in cultural life.

Homayoun Falakshahi stated that Iran's oil loading in August dropped to about 250,000 barrels per day. Iran's oil exports to China have effectively reached zero, and no tanker has been able to pass through the US naval blockade. Iran's oil revenue could reach zero by mid-December.

The US embassies in Israel, Jordan, and Qatar issued a security alert on Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar, stating that due to tensions in the Middle East, the security situation remains complex and there is a possibility of unforeseen escalation. The embassies asked American citizens to be vigilant and aware of possible flight cancellations, airspace closures, and travel disruptions. The alert said US diplomatic facilities have been targeted and that the Islamic Republic and its affiliated groups may target US interests and American citizens worldwide.

Keyvan Bana, a detainee from the December 2025 protests, was transferred to Torbat Heydariyeh prison to serve his sentence. He was sentenced to 10 years and one day of imprisonment. His charges include propaganda against the regime and espionage.

On Tuesday, Bandar Abbas, Qeshm, and Sirik were targeted by missile attacks. These attacks followed Donald Trump's promise of severe strikes on Iranian military targets. The United States carried out precise defensive strikes on positions in Bandar Abbas.

The virtual US embassy in Tehran warned its citizens not to travel to Iran for any reason and urged American citizens to leave Iran immediately. The warning is due to tensions and a complex security situation in the Middle East. There is also a possibility of flight cancellations and changes in border crossing procedures in Iran.

Scott Bessent, the US Treasury Secretary, announced that Washington has identified and will block the money and assets of the IRGC worldwide. He referred to the IRGC's accounts in the British Virgin Islands and $100 million homes of affiliates of the Islamic Republic. Bessent also said the US is 'burying the head of the poisonous snake of Iran' and stressed that a small group cannot remain in power forever.
IRIB news agency reported hearing an explosion sound in area 4 of Asaluyeh around 20:10 on Tuesday. The incident occurred at a specific time. No further details have been announced.

Donald Trump announced that the US military is conducting attacks on Iranian targets around the Strait of Hormuz. These attacks are in response to Iran's attempt to plant naval mines and missile launches at a US base in Jordan. Trump warned that if Iran retaliates, stronger attacks will follow.

The Tehran Revolutionary Court issued a death sentence for Ali Zarei, an eye injury victim of the 1401 protests. The Supreme Court also confirmed the death sentence for Ali Asghar Peygambari, a 26-year-old protester. These sentences are part of the ongoing wave of death sentences for protesters and political prisoners.
The US has launched a severe attack on southern Iran. Tehran has announced it will respond quickly. This news was reported by Niousha Saremi.

The Iranian Armed Forces Headquarters announced that in response to the US airstrike in Sistan-Baluchestan and Hormozgan, they will deliver crushing blows to the American enemy. Hossein Mohabi, spokesperson for the IRGC, stated that a severe punishment awaits the US. The US will regret its new attacks.
Two workers in the cities of Rafsanjan and Gachsaran died due to unsafe working conditions and lack of workplace safety while performing their jobs.

A citizen told Iran International that he and his wife, along with their two young children, have decided to migrate. His wife worked at a refinery and he was a nurse, but both were laid off. They are forced to migrate due to lack of financial and personal security.
A number of workers at Rajaei Port complained about wage arrears and job uncertainty. They demanded attention to their working conditions. This issue highlights the workers' labor problems.

Tractor football team drew 0-0 against Shams Azar in the fifth week of the Premier League in Qazvin. Tractor reached 13 points and temporarily remained at the top of the table. In other matches, Aluminium Arak defeated Gol Gohar, and Esteghlal Khuzestan drew with Chadormalu.

Donald Trump said that if Iran responds to US attacks, it could be completely destroyed. He warned that if Iran retaliates, there will be harsher attacks. Trump also made harsh remarks about the Iranian government and said that any agreement with them is worthless.

On the early morning of Tuesday, 3 Shahrivar, the execution of a prisoner in Sepidar Prison in Ahvaz was carried out. Also, a murder suspect in Tehran was sentenced to death. Two prisoners in Qazvin and Kerman were spared from execution after the victim's families expressed satisfaction.
IRIB reported that Jiroft civilian airport was targeted by a US attack. The news was released on the evening of Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar. Further information about the attack will be announced.

Donald Trump warned Tehran that if Iran retaliates against US attacks, they will face harsher targeting and may cease to exist if attacks continue. He described Tehran's actions as crazy and foolish and detailed recent attacks. Trump also expressed complete distrust in diplomacy with Iran.
The Islamic Republic of Iran Broadcasting news agency reported that Jiroft Airport in Kerman province was targeted on Tuesday night.

Abed Alizadeh, a citizen from Takab, was transferred to Miandoab prison after completing interrogation at the Intelligence Organization detention center in Urmia. This transfer took place on Monday, 9 Shahrivar.

The governor of Asaluyeh reported that around 20:10 on Tuesday night, an explosion was heard in the county. No details about casualties or financial damages have been released yet. This news was announced by the governor to Fars News Agency.

Media affiliated with the IRGC reported the start of Iranian missile and drone attacks on US positions. Fars and Tasnim news agencies announced the operation as a response to US attacks. US officials have not yet commented on these attacks.

At least 18 protests were held in various cities in Iran over the past two days. These protests involved hospital staff in Hakim Nishapur, green space contractors in Tehran, national housing applicants in Sanandaj, and other groups. Employees of the Pars Oil and Gas Company in the South Pars region also held protests.
Tasnim news agency reported that locations in Bandar Lengeh and Jask in Hormozgan province were targeted. This incident occurred on Tuesday night. No further details have been provided.

Mehdi Mahdavi Azad stated that the Intelligence Organization of the IRGC now issues permits for some Iranians abroad to return. These individuals are required to take a stance against opponents of the Islamic Republic or support the government in the war. In exchange, they are allowed to travel to and from Iran.
A video shows that on Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar, a missile fell in Khomain after launch. This incident was reported by Iran International.

Multiple severe explosions were reported around Qeshm and Bandar Abbas at 22:28 and 22:30. The sound of missile whistling was heard before the explosions. These explosions occurred in various areas including the Tolou Industrial Town of Qeshm.

Masoud Farhikhteh and Zartosht Ahmadi-Ragheb, two political prisoners in Karaj Central Prison, have been held in a separate room without basic facilities since July 30. They have been deprived of contact with their families, and family inquiries have so far been unsuccessful. The reason for these restrictions remains unclear.
The IRGC announced the start of operations in response to the US attacks on Tuesday night. The statement said that the US attacks would tighten the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.

On the evening of Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar, a vessel caught fire in the waters of Qeshm near the village of Salakh. This incident was reported based on a video received by Iran International. Further details have not been announced.
Several missiles have been launched from Khomein. The number of missiles reported is at least three. The sound of the launches was also heard from Aligudarz.
A missile has just been launched from Yazd. This news has been confirmed by various sources. Further details have not been announced.
Three missiles were launched from Khomein. The third image was received from the sky of Azna in Lorestan. This event was reported on Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar.

The deputy security official of Khuzestan province announced that on Tuesday evening, a location near Ahvaz city was targeted by a missile attack from the US military. This news was reported by Fars News Agency. No further details about the attack have been provided.
Missiles have been launched from Kermanshah at different times. Explosions and missile launches have been reported in the area. Sounds of fighter jets have also been heard.
Videos received by Iran International show missile launches by the Islamic Republic from Khomein on the evening of Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar.

Ahmad Nafisi, deputy governor of Hormozgan, announced that in a US attack on a residential house in the Kohestak area of Sirik, where a wedding ceremony was held, two people were killed and more than 20 injured. The wounded were transferred to Minab hospital and rescue forces were present at the scene. The investigation of the incident is ongoing and the final casualty figures will be announced after evaluation.

The status of the Kohestak telecommunications tower located in a residential area has been highlighted. This tower is situated in a residential region. No further details about its condition have been provided.
The audio version of the program 24 with Fardad Farahzad about the new round of US attacks on southern Iran has been released.
Mehr news agency reported air defense activity in east Tehran on Tuesday evening. This news was published by the Islamic Propagation Organization. The exact time of the event was Tuesday evening.

According to Tanker Trackers, Iran's crude oil exports in August 2026 dropped to zero. This represents a 100% decrease compared to the pre-war level in winter 1405. The report indicates a complete halt in Iran's crude oil exports during this period.
According to a video sent to Iran International, the Islamic Republic fired a missile from Tehran on Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar.

According to reports, on the evening of Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar, a car collided with a group participating in a nighttime government gathering on Eghbal Lahouri Boulevard in Mashhad. Several people were run over in this incident. This information comes from videos and reports received by Iran International.
A video has been released showing a car collision with a government gathering in Mashhad. The incident occurred on the evening of Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar. Several people were injured in this incident.

Video and reports received by Iran International indicate that the United States targeted a telecommunications tower in Sirik. This incident occurred in the Sirik area. No further details have been provided.

A video showing massive explosions in Qeshm after US attacks on the evening of Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar, has been released. The video was received by Iran International. No further details about the incident have been announced.

Traffic police reported that a Hyundai vehicle collided with a Changan vehicle and then struck a crowd supporting the regime. The driver was not in a normal state, resulting in several deaths and injuries. Government sources stated the accident was unintentional.

A citizen sent a video showing missile launches from Parand on Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar. In the video, a person is heard chanting "Death to the Islamic Republic." The video was sent to Iran International.

Reports indicate a US attack on a telecommunications tower near Sirik in southern Iran resulted in casualties among those attending a nearby wedding ceremony. Islamic Republic television reported at least four killed and 35 seriously injured. Ahmad Nafisi, deputy governor of Hormozgan, said a residential building hosting the wedding was hit during the attack.

Financial Times reported that Russia has secretly helped Iran develop advanced hypersonic cruise missiles. The program, codenamed C430L, started in 2023 and involves Russian experts assisting in ramjet propulsion system development. There is no evidence yet that these missiles have been operationally deployed.

The International Atomic Energy Agency has resolved remaining questions about Syria's nuclear activities and confirmed the Deir ez-Zor site as a reactor under construction. The agency praised the cooperation of new Syrian authorities but has made no progress regarding Iranian nuclear sites targeted by US and Israeli attacks. The agency expressed concern over lack of access to verify Iran's enriched uranium.

Kuwait's air defense is currently countering hostile drone attacks. The second statement adds that the defense is also addressing missile attacks. The army headquarters announced that explosion sounds are due to intercepting hostile targets.

The Jordanian army announced that its air defense systems intercepted 13 ballistic missiles and destroyed 10 of them. Three other missiles fell in remote areas with no casualties reported. The army urged people to avoid approaching missile debris and to follow official news sources.

The Kuwaiti Army General Staff announced that its air defense is responding to hostile drone attacks following Iran's aggression. The heard explosions are due to interception of these attacks. People have been asked to follow safety and security instructions.

Morad Veisi said that the Islamic Republic's move towards more conflict and war to force the US to break the oil blockade is unlikely to succeed. He added that intensifying conflict by the IRGC will not solve economic problems and will worsen the situation. This situation will continue until the fall of the Islamic Republic.

CENTCOM announced that US forces successfully executed attacks against Iranian military targets in response to recent IRGC attempts to attack commercial ships and US forces. The attacks targeted IRGC positions including air defense, radar, naval equipment, and communication centers. Iranian media reported at least 5 killed and 68 injured in the attack on Kuhestak Sirik.

Iranian government sources reported a heavy ballistic missile attack on the hangars of RQ-4 and MQ-9 long-range drones at Prince Hassan base. A number of drones were destroyed and some pilots and flight technical crew were killed, and technical infrastructure was set on fire. This was done in retaliation for the US bombing of a wedding celebration in Sirik, Hormozgan.

Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmail Baghaei wrote on X that a residential home in Kuhestak, Sirik, was targeted tonight while people were holding a wedding celebration. He stated that this attack cannot be separated from the chain of previous attacks and warned that the Islamic Republic will respond decisively.

France announced that the UN Security Council will vote this month on extending the mandate of the expert panel monitoring Iran sanctions. The mandate expires on September 26, with the vote expected on September 17. Russia and China may veto the extension, arguing the Security Council no longer has authority over the issue.

Xi Jinping, the President of China, arrived in Egypt on Tuesday, marking his first visit to the country in a decade. This visit coincides with regional countries reassessing their security and economic relations following the Iran war. China has also requested Iran to keep the Strait of Hormuz open without tolls.

The Russian newspaper Izvestia described the intensification of US sanctions against the Islamic Republic as a sign of the lack of a long-term strategy by Trump. The newspaper stated that the US cannot focus solely on the Middle East and that the sanctions may destabilize global energy markets. It also predicted that the Islamic Republic will continue to receive support through third countries.

Morad Veysi, a senior analyst at Iran International, said the US is combining economic pressure with military power against Iran. He referred to statements by US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent as more significant. He questioned whether the US is effectively moving toward the overthrow of the Islamic Republic.
Bahrain's news agency reported that the country's air defense systems tracked and destroyed Iranian drones over Bahrain. These systems are fully prepared to protect Bahrain's security.

G20 finance ministers emphasized the need to maintain free, safe, and predictable passage of ships through the Strait of Hormuz. The final statement of the G20 meeting expressed concern over disruptions in energy trade. All members except China agreed with the statement.

The Kuwaiti government has issued a decree allowing loans to be taken from the sovereign wealth fund with assets exceeding one trillion dollars to support financial resources. Repayment of these loans is prioritized if a budget surplus occurs, and cancellation or forgiveness without legal authorization is prohibited. These reforms are part of Kuwait's financial and legal changes.

Hossein Marashi stated that Beijing has set conditions for Qalibaf's trip to China. These conditions include reopening the Strait of Hormuz, not charging tolls, and resolving issues with Saudi Arabia and the United States. Qalibaf has been appointed as Iran's special representative for China affairs.

The US targeted two Iranian oil tankers in attacks on Tuesday. This attack is part of the new "tanker for tanker" policy approved by Donald Trump. The aim of these attacks is stated to reduce Tehran's threat against commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz.

Chris Wright, the US Energy Secretary, stated that 17 million barrels of oil were exported through the Strait of Hormuz on Monday. This is the highest level of crude oil passage through this waterway since the start of the Iran war and the reduction of oil flow. The news was reported by Reuters.

Donald Trump, the US President, wrote on Truth Social that, contrary to ABC's report, he is not trying to bring Iran to the negotiating table. He added that he does not care if Iran signs a worthless agreement and prefers the current situation with almost complete control over the Strait of Hormuz and Iran's collapsing economy. Trump also wrote, "When are the people of Iran going to rise up and fight?"

Tim Hawkins, spokesperson for CENTCOM, commented on reports of five killed and 68 injured at a wedding in southern Iran. He stated they are aware of these reports originating from Iranian state media. He also emphasized that the US military, unlike the IRGC, never targets civilians.

A senior US official told Fox News that after Tehran's retaliatory attacks, the status of all US forces is clear, and the United States intercepted "most" of the missiles fired by the Islamic Republic. He emphasized that most of the missiles and drones fired by the Islamic Republic were heading towards Jordan before being shot down, and none of the US bases in the Middle East sustained major damage. The official added that the command and control structure in Iran is not centralized, and it is still unclear who in the Revolutionary Guard Corps has survived or been killed.

The government of Peru announced it has cut diplomatic ties with the Islamic Republic of Iran due to concerns about the Middle East situation and human rights violations in Iran. Peru also condemned Iran's restrictions in the Strait of Hormuz and obstruction of the International Atomic Energy Agency's activities. Peru considers these actions a threat to international peace and security.

The aircraft carrier Abraham Lincoln entered Laem Chabang port in Thailand after more than 200 days on a mission in the Middle East. With about five thousand sailors, it set a record for the longest continuous time at sea. The carrier is scheduled to stay in Thailand for five days to rest and regroup.

Xi Jinping met and talked with Masoud Pezeshkian on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization meeting in Bishkek. The meeting was informal and took place in a corner of the hall. This event has sparked reactions and questions about the relationship between China and Iran.

Jerome Bonafon, the French ambassador to the UN, stated that the Iranian people are victims of decisions by the Islamic Republic and widespread repression. The Security Council will review Iran's compliance with nuclear commitments this month. He also expressed concerns about freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.

Scott Bessent, the US Treasury Secretary, described the Iranian people as "great people." He said Iranians should know they can become a normal country again. Bessent also mentioned that a small group cannot remain in power forever.

Scott Bassett, the US Treasury Secretary, stated that Washington continues to increase economic pressure on the Islamic Republic. He said sanctions and delays in salary payments have increased pressure on the regime's officials and forces. Bassett added that the Islamic Republic is going through its final stages.

Bourgan Nezami, an economist, stated that the dollar rate reached 215,000 tomans and recent fluctuations are due to sanctions and economic policies. He pointed to banking crises, inflation, and the devaluation of the rial. He warned of possible banking failures and increased demand for foreign currency in the coming months.

Amir Hayat-Moghaddam, a member of the presiding board of the Parliament's National Security Commission, called for acquiring and unveiling long-range intercontinental missiles to target American military bases in Washington and New York. He also emphasized designing a strategic plan to counter US hegemony and force the country to leave the region.

The Revolutionary Guard announced it shot down a US MQ-9 drone following US attacks. It also threatened that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed. Reports have emerged of attacks by the Islamic Republic on positions in Bahrain and Kuwait.

Arman Eshraghi, a financial economics professor, said that China's long-term economic interests do not align with the continuation of tensions by the Islamic Republic in the Middle East. He added that Iran's oil export dependence on China gives Beijing significant bargaining power. It seems unlikely that China will bear the costs of the Islamic Republic's tension-inducing policies in the long term.

China has amended its national defense mobilization law and increased domestic readiness for wartime conditions. Taiwan is testing ways to break the blockade and maintain the supply of essential goods. The number of Chinese ships around Taiwan reached a record 244 in July, and tensions have extended to the Pacific leaders' summit.

Mehdi Sarami Far stated that the Islamic Republic conducts part of its cyber operations through contracting companies and cybercriminal networks. Changing the names of companies like Mabna and Project Symbol does not change the true identity of the hackers. These networks operate simultaneously for government institutions and financial crimes against the public.

Mike Huckabee, the US ambassador to Israel, identified Hezbollah as the only obstacle to progress in Israel-Lebanon negotiations. He described Hezbollah as a group supported by the Islamic Republic responsible for killing hundreds of Americans. Huckabee also discussed the negotiations with Netanyahu and the US ambassador to Lebanon.

The Iraqi Football Federation signed a one-year contract with an Iranian coaching staff for the national girls' teams under 15 and under 17. Shadi Mohini was appointed head coach, with Maryam Azmoon and Rashin Hamidi as assistants. Their first mission is to lead the Iraq under-17 team in the Asian Cup qualifiers in Malaysia.
A video of a US airstrike on the village of Kohestak in Sirik, Hormozgan has been released. The video was published by official sources. The location of the airstrike has been identified.

The audio version of the Politics program with Murad Veisi has been released. This episode discusses the United States and the overthrow of the Islamic Republic. The program is broadcast by Iran International.

On Wednesday morning, the condition of several residential houses in Kohestak, Hormozgan was assessed. No further details about the condition of these houses were provided. This report pertains to Wednesday morning.

Manchester City finalized the transfer of Enzo Fernandez from Chelsea for 125 million pounds. The 25-year-old Argentine midfielder joined City to strengthen their midfield. Manchester City's total spending in this transfer window reached 458 million pounds.

Hassan Qashqavi stated that US sanctions create problems for Iran, but the Islamic Republic knows how to counter them. He added that Iran has faced sanctions and blockade for years and has greater economic resilience than before. Qashqavi called Trump's statements about the Strait of Hormuz and Iran's situation outright lies.

Sama Ghadirzadeh, a Bahá'í citizen residing in Yazd, was summoned by phone to the Yazd Intelligence Department on Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar. She was asked to appear at this security agency. This news was reported by the HRANA news agency.

Morteza Kazemian from Iran International says Trump has recently spoken more explicitly about the role of the Iranian people in the conflict with the Islamic Republic. These statements coincided with increased economic pressure from the US. It appears the Trump administration is paying more attention to Iran's internal conditions and the protesting society's reactions.

The euro price in Iran's free market surpassed 250,000 tomans for the first time, reaching 251,200 tomans. The dollar was traded at 217,000 tomans and the pound exceeded 292,000 tomans. Additionally, the UAE dirham and Turkish lira reached 59,650 tomans and 4,495 tomans respectively.

Mohammad Javad Akbarin from Iran International says that regional countries are more prepared than before to confront missile attacks by the Islamic Republic. He points to increased concerns in Qatar. Also, hope for mediation between the Islamic Republic and the US has diminished.

The Israeli army announced an attack on Hezbollah's infrastructure in the Nabatieh area in southern Lebanon. This attack was in response to the launch of two Hezbollah suicide drones. One of the drones was intercepted and destroyed.

A citizen responded to Donald Trump's question about the timing of the Iranian people's uprising. The citizen said Trump should side with the people and that if the regime leaders are targeted, it would create the conditions for an uprising. This response was presented on Iran International.

The governor of Isfahan denied rumors about holding the Esteghlal and Persepolis match without spectators. All necessary arrangements have been made for the game to be held with spectators. The match will take place on Wednesday, 11 Shahrivar, at the Naqsh-e Jahan Stadium.

The US Central Command announced that it targeted military centers of the Islamic Republic. The targets included air defense positions, radar systems, naval equipment, and communication centers of the Revolutionary Guards. This news was published by CENTCOM on the social network X.

Official media reported airstrikes by the US military on various locations in Iran, including Bandar Abbas, Qeshm, Sirik, and Khuzestan province. Several people, including children and military personnel, were killed or injured in these attacks. Additionally, damage was inflicted on telecommunications infrastructure and ports.
Mohammad Hamzehzadeh, a citizen of Mahabad, has been detained by security forces for 9 days. His place of detention remains unknown. His condition is still unclear.

The Islamic Republic of Iran is producing a documentary about the asylum of Iranian women's national football team members after the Asian Championship. The football federation has called players to a camp to film this documentary. This project has delayed the start of the women's Premier League by one week.

A video showing the destruction caused by US attacks in Sirik has been released. Official media of the Islamic Republic reported that these attacks resulted in the death and injury of several civilians at a wedding ceremony. The video was published on Wednesday, 11 Shahrivar.

Hossein Aghaei considers the US attacks on Islamic Republic targets as a sign of Washington's changing approach. He sees recent statements by Donald Trump and other US officials as a sign of moving towards regime change. However, this strategic signal has not yet become fully clear or operational.
A man in Mashhad strangled his 61-year-old wife due to family disputes, killing her. The suspect then attempted suicide. He was transferred to a medical center.

Donald Trump's question about when the Iranian people will rise up against the Islamic Republic drew widespread reactions from Iran International's audience. Some responders stressed that a nationwide uprising requires serious weakening of the repression apparatus and clarity on the US strategy. They said they need assurance they will not be left alone this time before returning to the streets.

Jordan announced it intercepted and destroyed 10 out of 13 ballistic missiles. Kuwait also countered drone attacks, with one drone hitting a residential complex in the capital. Egypt and Qatar condemned the attacks, calling them a threat to regional security.

Twenty Premier League clubs spent over 4 billion euros on summer transfers, setting a new record. Manchester City led the spending with 458 million pounds, signing players like Enzo Fernandez. The spending continued until the final hours of the transfer window.
A video shows the destruction of residential houses in Sirik. This destruction is due to US attacks on probable targets in the area. The attacks occurred on Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar.

The trial session of Mahbubeh Shabani, a detainee from the December 2025 protests, was held at the first branch of the Revolutionary Court in Mashhad. She is accused of operational actions to strengthen Israel, the USA, and opposition groups. Shabani has been on a hunger strike in Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad since August 20.

Iranian media reported that a missile hit a wedding ceremony in Kohestak Sirik, killing at least five people and injuring 68. The injured were transferred to hospitals in Sirik and Minab. The Abolfazl Minab hospital is facing a blood shortage and has requested blood donations from citizens.

Raul Asensio, Real Madrid defender, was fined 14,400 euros and banned from driving for eight months due to drunk driving in the Canary Islands. His alcohol test showed four times the legal limit, and his case was escalated to a criminal offense against road safety. Asensio is also facing another legal case for charges including breach of privacy and unauthorized content disclosure.

The director of treatment at the Drug Control Headquarters stated that 20 to 30 percent of the 16 million student population smoke cigarettes. The use of psychoactive substances has also spread among university students. He mentioned the existence of 300 types of drugs and psychoactive substances in the country and the spread of addiction among various social groups.
The deputy director of intelligence for southern Tehran province announced the identification and arrest of nearly 100 people in Rey County during the recent conflict.

The 107th derby between Esteghlal and Persepolis will be held at the Naghshe Jahan Stadium in Isfahan. Some fans who were killed during the National Iranian Revolution are absent from this match. This derby serves as a reminder of those who could have been present in the stands.

Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, wrote on X after the US army attacks on southern Iran that Iran's new strategy in war, diplomacy, and economic siege confrontation will break the enemy's foundation. He emphasized that the enemies will not escape their current situation. These statements were made following the Tuesday night attacks.

The interrogation session of Reza Saliani, a political activist, was held at Tehran's public and revolutionary prosecutor's office. He faced charges including propaganda against the regime and defended himself. At the end of the session, he was released on bail.

Morteza Aghatehrani, head of the parliamentary cultural commission, spoke about the increasing prevalence of nudity and the inadequacy of the current hijab situation. He emphasized that the law was written to prevent nudity and unveiling, and prevention is better than cure. Aghatehrani also referred to Pezeshkian's reaction to videos of nudity in the city.

In the fifth week of the Persian Gulf Pro League, the 107th Tehran derby between Esteghlal and Persepolis will be held. The match will take place on Wednesday in Isfahan. This news was explained by Mazdak Mirzaei.

The head of the support commission for lawyers in the Fars region announced the formation of judicial cases against about 20 lawyers in Fars province following the protests of December 1404. Twelve of these lawyers have been arrested, and some have received final prison sentences.

Axios reported, citing US officials, that the US military targeted two Iranian government oil tankers during Tuesday night strikes near the Iranian coast. American drones struck the tankers' engine rooms with missiles. A US official described the action as part of a new 'tanker-for-tanker' policy approved by Donald Trump.

Miad Maleki, former head of the Treasury Department's sanctions targeting office, stated that new sanctions focus on intermediaries, exchange offices, and individuals enabling Iran's access to the global financial system and oil revenues. These sanctions increase economic pressure on Iran.

The price of the euro in Iran surpassed 255,000 tomans for the first time. The US dollar was reported around 220,000 tomans and the UAE dirham over 60,000 tomans. The central bank governor stated that the central bank is ready to supply up to two billion dollars to control the market.

Eisa Sohrabi, the director general of education in Lorestan, reported about 600 dilapidated schools in the province. This situation is a major challenge in the education sector and may threaten student safety. Coordination difficulties between the education department and the school renovation organization have also slowed the renovation process.

The average daily gasoline consumption in the first week of Shahrivar exceeded 148 million liters. The highest daily demand during this period was over 154 million liters. The Iranian government stated there is no problem in gasoline supply, but production capacity has decreased.

The head of the Martyrs and Veterans Center of Fajr Corps in Fars stated that in the early Wednesday attacks by the US on Jahrom county, a member of the Khatam al-Anbiya Base and a Basiji from Fasa Corps was killed. Iranian media had not reported any explosion in Jahrom on Tuesday night or early Wednesday.

Mohammad Abolhasani, a civil activist, was released from Choubinder Prison in Qazvin after completing his sentence. This release took place on Wednesday, 11 Shahrivar. Harana News Agency reported this news.
Masoud Pezeshkian met with Xi Jinping amid increased US pressure on the Islamic Republic. Hossein Marashi made statements about China's conditions. This issue has sparked widespread reactions.

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told Newsmax that the US goal in sanctioning the Islamic Republic is not necessarily the collapse of the regime, although such an event might occur. Bessent added that people might revolt due to 100% inflation, long queues, and unpaid military salaries. He also stated that the reason the memorandum of understanding failed was that the Iranians were not ready for an agreement, and the US will ensure they want to agree.
A citizen sent a video to Iran International showing the empty refrigerator in his home. He said they have nothing to eat. The video highlights his living conditions.

Ingrid Alexandra, the Crown Princess of Norway, signed an oath of loyalty to the constitution following the death of her grandfather, King Harald. Her father, King Haakon, also took an oath in a parliamentary ceremony. Masoud Qarakhani, the Iranian-Norwegian parliament speaker, presided over the ceremony.

Mehrān Abbāsiyān, a reporter for Iran International, reports that Haakon VIII took the oath in the Norwegian parliament to begin his reign. The ceremony marking the start of his kingship was held in Norway. This event was officially conducted in the Norwegian parliament.

Mehrdad Moshtaghi, a fan of Esteghlal and Real Madrid, was injured in Arak after being shot in the head by the suppressive forces of the Islamic Republic. He underwent surgery but died due to brain death and cardiac arrest. Esteghlal fans held a banner with his name before the 107th Tehran derby at the Naqsh-e Jahan Stadium.

Companies owned by Mohammadreza Ghafoori-Fard received over two million dollars in contracts from Canadian federal and provincial agencies. These companies had contracts with the Royal Canadian Mounted Police and the Canadian Ministry of Defense. Ghafoori-Fard is under security investigations regarding possible cooperation with the Islamic Republic's military programs.

The Islamic Republic returned from the Shanghai summit with a supportive statement. A brief meeting between Pezeshkian and Xi Jinping and talks between China and the US about Iran also took place on the sidelines. Mehdi Beigi analyzed these signs regarding the real relationship between Tehran and Beijing.

At dawn on Wednesday, September 2, the execution of a prisoner named Aziz Roshanai was carried out in Adelabad Prison in Shiraz. The prisoner had previously been sentenced to death for murder. Harana News Agency reported this news.

Marco Rubio, US Secretary of State, said anything that poses an immediate threat to US forces or global shipping in the Strait of Hormuz will be targeted. He added that the strait will remain open and will not be under Iran's control, and this is what the US president is now doing.

Marco Rubio, the US Secretary of State, stated that no country should help Iran evade sanctions or create mechanisms for their income. He said Iran's money is spent on supporting terrorist and paramilitary groups, not its people. Rubio emphasized that Iran aims to finance terrorism and develop nuclear weapons, and the US will not allow this.

The Supreme Court approved the retrial in Alireza Sepahi's case. The peer branch rejected the retrial without holding a hearing and sent the case to enforcement of the death sentence. This case concerns a prisoner sentenced to death in Isfahan.

A group of job seekers protested for the third consecutive day in front of the Deybal Khazaei Agro-Industry Company in Ahvaz. The protesters demand the employment of local residents in the industrial unit. This protest took place today.

Donald Trump, the President of the United States, proposed renaming the Strait of Hormuz to the Trump Strait in a post on Truth Social. He wrote: Now that we control it, should we change the name of the Strait of Hormuz to the 'Trump Strait'?

In the deadliest night of military clashes in the Persian Gulf since the ceasefire, the US attacked 100 targets in 40 locations in Iran, killing at least 19 people. After these attacks, Trump referred to the imminent economic collapse of Iran. He also asked when the people of Iran would revolt.

Donald Trump, President of the United States, said in an interview with the 'Dan Patrick' podcast that the US now controls the Strait of Hormuz and destroyed 28 ships last night. He also claimed that the Islamic Republic was two weeks away from having a nuclear weapon, and if they had obtained it, Israel and the Middle East would have been destroyed and they would have attacked US cities.

Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, announced that Iran will use a new strategy in the ongoing war. He warned that US efforts to exit the current situation will be futile. Rezaei said this new strategy will break the foundations of the US in the battlefield, diplomacy, and economic siege confrontation.
